title: New Aircraft & Stunning Liveries in MSFS Marketplace! ✈️✨ | Weekly Update | Week 46
description:
🔍 Description
🚀 Discover the latest additions to the Microsoft Flight Simulator (MSFS) marketplace this week! 🚀 Dive into the details of the new aircrafts and explore the stunning liveries that will elevate your flying experience. This week not to many items however a new high quality aircraft has landed in the MSFS marketplace: the RJ Professional. In addition a new livery pack and sound pack have been added.. Whether you’re a seasoned pilot or a virtual aviation enthusiast, this update is a must-see! Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more MSFS content. 🌍🛫

📹 Other marketplace additions
